name: Jeflin Mathew
role: Digital Marketing · SEO · Meta Ads · Lead Generation
lede: Digital marketer who grows organic search traffic and runs lead generation campaigns.
about: I am a Digital Marketing Executive with one year of professional experience in SEO, Meta Ads, lead generation, social media marketing and content optimization.
My SEO work covers keyword research, on-page and technical SEO, audits, schema markup, indexing and crawl analysis, and Google Search Console monitoring.
Before marketing I worked in media operations, social media management, audience analysis, quality control and team coordination.

seo.chartTitle: Search Console · first month vs final month
seo.source: Compared using the first and last month of my employment.

steps.name: Keyword research
steps.desc: Find the terms the audience searches for and group them by intent.

steps.name: On-page optimization
steps.desc: Align titles, headings and copy on each page with its target term.

steps.name: Technical audit
steps.desc: Check indexing, crawlability and site health for issues that hold pages back.

steps.name: Fixes
steps.desc: Resolve what the audit found and confirm the affected pages are indexed.

steps.name: Schema and internal linking
steps.desc: Add structured data and link related pages so search engines can read the site.

steps.name: Search Console monitoring
steps.desc: Track clicks, impressions, position and CTR to see what changed.

metrics.name: Total clicks
metrics.note: Monthly clicks from search more than doubled, from 3.46K to 7.59K.

metrics.name: Total impressions
metrics.note: Impressions nearly tripled, so the pages appeared in search far more often.

metrics.name: Average position
metrics.hint: Lower is better. A shorter bar is a higher ranking.
metrics.note: Average position moved from page two to page one of results.

metrics.name: Average CTR
metrics.note: CTR fell by 0.2 points while impressions nearly tripled.
